narrative.northStar: The Operator's Console, Lit From Behind
narrative.overview:
The site is the dark theme of the product's own design book, not a separate brand skin. Layout follows Linear: big quiet headlines with a grey continuation, hairlines instead of boxed cards, and the product as the hero.

Product frames are drawn as Windows 11 windows, because that is the club market's OS. Density is generous, motion is decorative and switchable: lite mode turns decoration off and keeps the meaning.
keyCharacteristics: Dark neutral canvas, one emerald accent, amber reserved for urgency.
System font stack only, no web fonts, tight negative tracking on large sizes.
Hairline (8% white) borders and 2% white fills rather than solid cards.
Glow is the only decoration: emerald, radial, low opacity.
Status chips carry honesty: filled for shipped, dashed for planned.

rules.name: The Amber Means Burning Rule
rules.body: Amber appears only for time under five minutes, a missing link, or the offline state. If nothing is on fire, the screen has no amber.

rules.name: The One Emerald Rule
rules.body: Emerald is brand and action. It fills at most one button per view; everything else is outline, ink or soft fill.

rules.name: The Grey Continuation Rule
rules.body: Section headlines state the point in ink and continue in ink-3; no second typeface, no colour for emphasis.

rules.name: The Glow Is Light Rule
rules.body: Emerald glow is soft, radial and low-contrast, a light source behind the product. No hard offset shadows, no glow around text.

rules.name: The Lite Rule
rules.body: Every decorative effect must have an html.lite off state.

dos: Do take colour, radius, shadow and motion values from the product tokens and reference them by name.
Do show the real Panel and guest screens as the proof; draw frames as Windows 11 windows.
Do mark every capability with the filled or dashed chip.
Do keep the 44 px minimum target (tabs 44, buttons 48+) and the 3 px visible focus outline.
Do give every motion effect a lite fallback and keep the page readable without JavaScript.
donts: Don't use amber for anything that is not urgent.
Don't use macOS traffic lights or web fonts.
Don't put solid heavy boxes around content; hairline and 2% white fill instead.
Don't invent clients, reviews, numbers or prices; the programme is not yet in any club.
Don't return to the old generic "dead and dry" SaaS template look.
